name: Palos de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Palos de la Frontera (a ship above waves within a bordure of anchors and hearts).
history: The town council has used its seal to validate its documents since 1968; the flag of Palos de la Frontera is composed of three stripes parallel to each other and perpendicular to the hoist, of equal size.

features.role: Palos de la Frontera arms — ship above waves within a bordure of anchors and hearts
